format: UCWDC Couples Open and Masters age divisions (future UCWDC body profile)

source.quote_free_summary: Open and Masters competitors must be adults, except in couples where an adult may dance with a partner aged 16 or above.

requirement: The partner-aged-16-or-above exception is NOT available in the initial Studio/Custom release: DanceFlow's OD-02 launch policy prohibits all competitors under 18. The setup wizard states this next to the Masters/Open age divisions (the enforcing gate is PR 835 and must ship with or before this wording). A future UCWDC profile that lifts OD-02 must model the exception deliberately.
enforcement_point: Wording only (division axis note). Enforcement of the under-18 refusal is OD-02 (PR 835), not part of this change; DanceFlow does not enforce UCWDC age eligibility.

tests.name: the age axis note keeps the original text and adds the unavailability statement

interpretation_notes: Re-read 2026-11-23 in the pinned PDF (II.D.3, page 3 of 17): Masters (II.D.3.b) and Open (II.D.3.a) competitors must be Adults, with the phrase 'a partner who is 16 years of age or above' as the exception. Not implemented, by owner decision OD-32 (AE-08). Known residual: the stored profile's hidden Open value note for Country Couples still says an adult may dance with a partner 16 or older; it is not rendered.
